meta.notes: A firefly of its own (msm:particle): a round glow drawn from textures/particle/firefly_glow_0.png to _3.png that pulses (animation loop, a frame every 4 ticks) and glows in the dark (emissive). Each lives 40 to 80 ticks (lifetime min and max), fades in and out (fade in_out) and rises very slowly (gravity -0.02) while friction 0.9 slows any push. Lowering lists the pictures in the description assets/msm_examples/particles/firefly_glow.json. It needs the Fabric mod jar export, on the server and on every client.
